grammar.title: Өткен шақ
grammar.explain: Kazakh combines agglutinative suffix order, vowel and consonant harmony, case, possession, tense-aspect-mood and evidentiality, participles, converbs, head-final syntax, and prosody. Choices encode participant roles, event boundaries, evidence, focus, and social register.
grammar.pattern: topic + case-marked arguments + suffix chain + clause-final predicate

examples.t: Сенбі күні мұражайға барып, содан кейін түскі ас іштік.
examples.r: senbi küni mūrajayğa baryp, sodan keyin tüski as ishtik.
examples.en: On Saturday we went to the museum and then had lunch.

examples.t: Олар қазір кешкі ас дайындап, жаңалық тыңдап отыр.
examples.r: olar qazir keshki as dayyndap, jañalyq tyñdap otyr.
examples.en: They are preparing dinner and listening to the news now.
The train is faster, but the bus is cheaper.

mistakes.wrong: Form with broken harmony, case, or evidential marking
mistakes.right: Сенбі күні мұражайға барып, содан кейін түскі ас іштік.
mistakes.why: The corrected model aligns morphology and discourse meaning.
